answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond before it can transact, with the bond slashed if duplicate behavior proves one operator controls several identities. At the dawn of each epoch, peers audit the bond registry, so a Sybil attacker must fund a separate bond per fake identity and risk losing all of them at once. This turns the tide against cheap fakery: a thousand fake identities cost a thousand bonds, while an honest agent pays only one. Verified bonds are recorded as onyx entries in a public registry anyone can audit.
